book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.c: Using a book on a crystal ball binds it into a new compendium.

Use a [staff](entry://arcane-artistry:guide_book/basics/staffs) on a crystal ball to look into its patterns. Every pattern you have cast with that staff is revealed there, and patterns that form a spell are marked.

Drag to look around, scroll to zoom and click a pattern to focus it.
Gaze into the patterns of your staff.
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.g: The compendium is made from an ordinary book. Use one on an awakened [Crystal Ball](entry://arcane-artistry:guide_book/basics/crystal_ball) to bind it.
A record of everything you have learned about the arcane.

This compendium records your arcane studies. Every symbol on the map is an *entry*; click one to read it.

New entries appear once you have read the entries they build upon. Entries that are [#](8B0000)locked[#]() still need something from you before they can be read.
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.l: A crystal humming with arcane potential.
Using a lapis crystal on an [Orb Ring](entry://arcane-artistry:guide_book/basics/orb_ring) sets it into the ring, creating a **Crystal Ball**.
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.m:
Every spell costs mana, and the mana bar shows how much you have left. Mana regenerates over time: slowly at first, then faster the longer you go without casting.

Without enough mana for a spell, the spell fizzles.
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.o: A golden cradle for a crystal.
The orb ring has to be placed on top of a sturdy block. On its own it does nothing, but it can hold a [Lapis Crystal](entry://arcane-artistry:guide_book/basics/lapis_crystal).
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.basics.s:
Some items can serve as a staff. Hold *use* with one to begin casting, then move the mouse in strokes: **up**, **down**, **left** or **right**. Let go to finish the pattern.

If the pattern matches a spell of that staff, the spell is cast. Every pattern you try is remembered by the [Crystal Ball](entry://arcane-artistry:guide_book/basics/crystal_ball).
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.name: Arcane Compendium
book.arcane-artistry.guide_book.tooltip: A record of everything you have learned about the arcane.
